codes.evidence_quote: Anselmo González Climent, un clásico de la investigación del tema «jondo», cuyos rigurosos análisis... han promovido la aparición de una nueva generación de estudiosos del flamenco.
codes.target: Anselmo González Climent and scholarly interpretation of the jondo
codes.rationale: The passage authorizes flamenco knowledge through a named researcher whose rigorous analyses are credited with shaping later scholarship.

codes.evidence_quote: Es una reunión de cabales aunque alguno de ellos, por primera vez, hayan sentido el cante
codes.target: the Buenos Aires gathering of listeners/interpreters
codes.rationale: The gathering is framed as one of cabales, granting participant status and interpretive seriousness to the group.

codes.evidence_quote: el cante es el arte del júpio o del grito plástico... la letra pierde territorio... para que el júpio ascienda y baje, provoque climas muy sutiles
codes.rationale: The passage defines flamenco value through aesthetic criteria of cry, trance, subtle atmosphere, and independence from literal text.

derived_analysis.target: expert and insider interpretation of cante jondo

annotation_notes: Truncated article; codes are based only on visible opening/window/ending text.

codes.evidence_quote: gran parte del público recién iniciado en el sentimiento del arte flamenco, vayan estas líneas con la sola intención de arrojar alguna luz sobre el tema
codes.rationale: The author explicitly frames the article as explanatory mediation for beginners seeking access to flamenco understanding.

codes.evidence_quote: toda la miseria, hambre e injusticias a que ha sido sometido el pueblo llano andaluz
codes.target: the Andalusian common people as embodied in flamenco expression
codes.rationale: The flamenco cry is tied to a specific collective identity and historical suffering, making group identity central to the meaning of cante.

codes.evidence_quote: la invasión de otros gustos musicales que nada tienen que ver con la esencial naturaleza del alma andaluza
codes.target: other musical tastes opposed to Andalusian flamenco essence
codes.rationale: The passage draws an exclusionary boundary between flamenco's essential Andalusian nature and external musical tastes presented as unrelated.

derived_analysis.target: the flamenco ay as expression of Andalusian suffering and essence

codes.evidence_quote: Si olvidamos este factor esencial no se pudiera explicar por qué los Andaluces... adoptaron su rara música oriental, se reconocieron en ella y la hicieron suya
codes.target: the historical roots of the siguiriya gitana in Andalusian/Gitano encounter
codes.rationale: The passage grounds the meaning of the siguiriya in origins, historical continuity, and rooted cultural encounter.

codes.evidence_quote: los Andaluces, después de acoger en sus pueblos a los Gitanos perseguidos y de convivir con ellos, adoptaron su rara música oriental, se reconocieron en ella y la hicieron suya
codes.target: Andalusian and Gitano identity in the formation of the siguiriya
codes.rationale: Identity groups are used to explain belonging, adoption, and representation within the development of the flamenco form.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The text discusses interpretation and historical explanation, but not learning access, pedagogy, or transmission across institutional/social boundaries.

derived_analysis.target: the siguiriya gitana as historically rooted Andalusian-Gitano expression

annotation_notes: Truncated article; codes are based only on visible opening/window/ending text.

codes.evidence_quote: Nuestro arte sirve continuamente de vehículo expresivo a este puñado de novelistas honestos y arriesgados
codes.target: new Andalusian novelists using flamenco/jondo material
codes.rationale: The passage explicitly evaluates the writers positively and values their use of flamenco as expressive material.

codes.evidence_quote: este Sur doliente, que clama, desde hace siglos, por una redención que nunca llega. Nuestro Sur...
codes.target: Andalusian/Southern identity represented through flamenco and literature
codes.rationale: The passage frames flamenco-inflected narrative through a collective regional identity and shared historical suffering.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The excerpt discusses literary periods and characteristics, but the visible flamenco-related evidence does not clearly canonize or rank flamenco artists, styles, or works.

derived_analysis.target: flamenco as an expressive vehicle in new Andalusian narrative
